fixture: Mirrored from VargaFoundation/choregos-agents#8, commit 7e9c41754191415ad92e296ba09b6b15c2719790: the servicenow server (plugins/servicenow/server) on its fake instance (SERVICENOW_FAKE=1), recorded on 2026-11-05 while the core's eval doors played E3 and C1 in both cells against it (#1372). `tools` is what it lists, `answers` what it answered to each call those plays made (the platform's action_key left out). Served by choregos_adapters.fakes.plugin_servers.FakePluginServer.

tools.description:
Search a table with typed filters (joined by AND) and free-text terms (each matched in the
        title or the description). Tables: incident, sc_req_item, change_request, problem, kb_knowledge,
        cmdb_ci, cmdb_rel_ci, sys_user_group, sys_choice, sys_journal_field. At most 50 records.

Filter.description: One condition: `{"field": "state", "op": "eq", "value": "2"}`. Conditions are joined by AND.

field.description: a field of the table, e.g. state, assignment_group, cmdb_ci
field.title: Field

value.description: a string; a list for op=in; nothing for is_empty / is_not_empty
value.title: Value

Filter.title: Filter

tools.name: search_records

tools.description: Read one record by sys_id, or by number (INC…, RITM…, CHG…, PRB…, KB…).
tools.name: get_record

tools.description: The work notes (internal) and comments (customer-visible) of a record, newest first.
tools.name: get_journal

tools.description: A configuration item of the CMDB, by sys_id or by name.
tools.name: get_ci

tools.description: The relations of a CI (depends on, runs on, connected by…), in both directions.
tools.name: list_ci_relations

tools.description: Published knowledge articles matching the terms (drafts and retired articles are never returned).
tools.name: search_knowledge

tools.description:
Resolved or closed incidents of the last `days` days (90 by default) on the same CI or matching
        the terms; from an incident's sys_id, its CI and the words of its title are used.
tools.name: similar_incidents

tools.description: Add an internal work note (not visible to the caller). Idempotent: a replay adds nothing.
tools.name: add_work_note

tools.description:
Change category, subcategory, impact, urgency, assignment_group, assigned_to or cmdb_ci (references
        by sys_id). Never priority. `fields` is an object (or its JSON text). Returns the previous values,
        which undo the change.
tools.name: update_record

tools.description: Add a comment the CALLER sees. Always approved by a person first.
tools.name: add_comment

tools.description:
Resolve an incident with a close code and close notes. Always approved by a person first;
        undone by reopen_incident with the returned previous_state.
tools.name: resolve_incident

tools.description: Reopen a resolved incident, to `state` (a stored state value) or In Progress.
tools.name: reopen_incident

tools.description:
Create a change request. Always approved by a person first. Idempotent through its
        correlation_id: a replay returns the change already created.
tools.name: create_change_request

tools.description: A work item (incident, request item or change) by number, with its journal. See TRACKER_PROFILE.md.
tools.name: tracker_fetch_item

tools.description: File an incident. Idempotent through its correlation_id.
tools.name: tracker_create_item

tools.description: Move a work item to a state by its label (closing states go through tracker_close).
tools.name: tracker_set_state

tools.description: Add an internal work note to a work item. Idempotent.
tools.name: tracker_comment

tools.description: Reflect Choregos's status as a work note; adds one only when the status text changed.
tools.name: tracker_upsert_status

tools.description: Close a delivered work item. Idempotent: closing a closed item does nothing.
tools.name: tracker_close

tools.description: Keys of the active work items in the configured assignment groups, oldest first.
tools.name: tracker_list_candidates

tools.description: Verify and normalise a webhook delivery (the same rules as POST /events).
tools.name: tracker_parse_event

arguments.text: 10 similar incidents resolved in the last 90 days. CHG0003311 resolved INC0012102, INC0012160. Knowledge: KB0010042. Next step for Network: check the MTU on vpn-lyon-01 and set it back to 1400 through a change.

Ten similar incidents resolved in the last 90 days. INC0012102 and INC0012160 were resolved by CHG0003311, the MTU lowered to 1400 on the Lyon concentrator; KB0010042: a firmware upgrade resets it to 1500, and the concentrator was upgraded last weekend. Next step for Network: check the MTU on vpn-lyon-01 and set it back to 1400 through a change.

entries.value: The fix on the Lyon VPN is in place, thank you for your patience.
Same capture as INC0012102; waiting for CHG0003311.
Your provider replaced your router; tell us if the drops come back.
Closed as a duplicate of INC0012268.
Provider ticket opened; link back at 11:40.
Password expired on the day of the drop; reset.
CHG0003311 implemented: large copies complete, the tunnel holds.
Packet capture on vpn-lyon-01: packets over 1400 bytes are fragmented and dropped. CHG0003311 raised to lower the MTU.
Still slow, I cannot work like this.

fields.short_description: Lyon site: VPN drops during large file transfers
VPN to the Lyon site drops: check the MTU on the Lyon concentrator
fields.text: Symptom: VPN tunnels of the Lyon site drop and come back on their own; large transfers and video calls fail first. Cause: packets over 1400 bytes are fragmented between the site and its concentrator, vpn-lyon-01. Fix: set the MTU to 1400 on the Lyon concentrator, as CHG0003311 did. A firmware upgrade of the concentrator resets the MTU to 1500: check it after each upgrade.

fields.text: Month-end batch jobs load db-prod-01. Run reports outside 08:00-10:00.
